t: The LAP Tomman outdoor LED wall light is a solar-powered security light designed to illuminate dark exterior areas. This wall-mounted fixture is ideal for domestic driveways, pathways and garden patios, providing trade professionals and homeowners with a reliable safety solution. Featuring a durable black aluminium body and a glass diffuser, the unit delivers a bright 650 lumen daylight output. An integrated PIR sensor detects motion up to 8m away across a 120° angle, whilst the pre-set dusk-to-dawn sensor ensures efficient operation by only activating when natural light levels fall.
